full_text:
Article 5 (Duties of Division Commander, etc.)
(1) The Division Commander shall exercise overall control over the affairs of the division and command and supervise the establishment units and units subordinated or assigned to the division (hereinafter referred to as "units under command").
(2) The Deputy Division Commander shall assist the Division Commander and act on the Division Commander's behalf if the Division Commander is unable to perform duties due to an unavoidable reason.
(3) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Division Commander and coordinate, control, and supervise staff duties.
